mapping_note: Direct mappings cover global and explicit-set registration, registration results, and explicit member-handle validity (clauses 4.14–4.15); announcement labels/tags (4.16); default-set late-join participation and achievement results (4.17.1); and completion/failure-set callbacks (4.18.2). Pre-connect/pre-join lifecycle failures, duplicate-label failure, and re-achievement after completion are supplemental assertions here and are not separate direct mappings.
notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 federation synchronization-point surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies global and explicit-set registration, registration-result callbacks, announcement tags, late-join announcement, achievement success/failure, completion, duplicate-label and invalid-member failures, and pre-connect/pre-join service boundaries without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.
